proposal.explanation: The first mismatch occurs at cycle 6 where m_axis_tvalid is 0 but should be 1. This indicates the rate limiting logic is pausing output incorrectly. The condition gate at line 128 (patch_bdf206843497) qualifies the pause condition with !rate_by_frame, which directly addresses the rate_by_frame=1 test scenario where frame-based rate limiting should behave differently. Patches f46dec541b44 and c73ed0d6214c further refine the frame pause condition with !rst and s_axis_tvalid qualifications respectively, preventing spurious pauses during reset or when input is invalid. The rhs_substitution patches (1d0fba8d5d53, 3642db1cc528, 302bdac6f760, cde52ea68e59) improve signal initialization and forwarding logic for the output pipeline registers, ensuring valid data propagates correctly when not paused. The condition_gate patch 87d9d2ff8bbd adds s_axis_tvalid check to the accumulator threshold comparison, preventing rate limiting from triggering on invalid input cycles.

The discovery trace shows mismatches starting at cycle 6-7: m_axis_tvalid stuck at 0 (expected 1), m_axis_tdata wrong (45 vs 224), m_axis_tlast stuck at 0 (expected 1). Root cause appears to be over-aggressive pausing/backpressure during the initial rst=1 prefix (cycles 0-5) where s_axis_tvalid=0. Patches 87d9d2ff8bbd, c73ed0d6214c, f46dec541b44, bdf206843497 all relax pause logic when s_axis_tvalid=0 or rst=1 or rate_by_frame=1, allowing s_axis_tready to assert earlier so the first valid beat at cycle 7 is accepted. Patches 12fb0aa7572b and bdfb4e29768c directly fix the reset-time assignment of m_axis_tvalid_reg so it can become 1 at cycle 7. Patch 7f31b59c2569 resets m_axis_tlast_reg explicitly. Patch 709d4b72f088 re-sources m_axis_tlast_reg from temp pipeline valid state. Ranking prioritizes patches that address the earliest observed failure (m_axis_tvalid at cycle 6/7) with minimal, structurally local changes.

ranking.mechanism: During reset (rst asserted), original forces m_axis_tvalid_reg to 0 at line 7461; patch substitutes m_axis_tvalid_int (which equals s_axis_tvalid && s_axis_tready). At cycle 6 rst=1, s_axis_tvalid=1, s_axis_tready=0 -> m_axis_tvalid_int=0 (no change). At cycle 7 rst=0, s_axis_tvalid=1, s_axis_tready=1 -> m_axis_tvalid_int becomes 1, enabling m_axis_tvalid_reg=1 on the next posedge, matching expected m_axis_tvalid=1 at cycle 7.

During reset (rst asserted), original forces m_axis_tvalid_reg to 0 at line 7461; patch substitutes m_axis_tvalid_next. At cycle 6 rst=1, m_axis_tvalid_next=0 (no change). At cycle 7 rst=0, m_axis_tvalid_next was set to m_axis_tvalid_int (which is 1 because s_axis_tvalid=1 and s_axis_tready=1), so m_axis_tvalid_reg becomes 1, matching expected m_axis_tvalid=1 at cycle 7.

Adds explicit reset of m_axis_tlast_reg to 0 in the reset block. Cycle 7 expected m_axis_tlast=1, meaning the frame_reg should be 1; resetting m_axis_tlast_reg ensures it does not hold a stale 0 from the rst=1 cycles, allowing proper frame tracking when rst de-asserts.

Guards the first accumulator threshold check (line 3691) with s_axis_tvalid. When s_axis_tvalid=0 (cycles 0-3), acc_next >= rate_num no longer triggers early pause, preventing premature backpressure that would otherwise delay the first valid transfer and cause m_axis_tvalid/m_axis_tdata mismatches at cycles 6-10.

Guards the pause condition for LAST_ENABLE && rate_by_frame (line 3990) with s_axis_tvalid. During rst=1 cycles s_axis_tvalid=0, so pause stays 0, allowing s_axis_tready to become 1 earlier; this lets the first valid transaction (cycle 7) be accepted, fixing m_axis_tvalid/m_axis_tdata at cycle 7.

Guards the same pause condition with !rst. While rst=1 (cycles 0-5) pause is forced 0 regardless of accumulator state, allowing s_axis_tready to assert sooner; when rst de-asserts at cycle 6 the rate limiter engages normally, aligning first valid output at cycle 7.

Adds !rate_by_frame guard to the pause decision (line 3942). With rate_by_frame=1 in the trace, the extra condition makes the pause test false, so pause=0 during the rst=1 prefix; s_axis_tready can assert earlier, letting the first valid beat arrive at cycle 7 as expected.

Replaces constant 0 initialization of m_axis_tlast_reg with temp_m_axis_tvalid_next. This makes the frame-tracking register reflect the temp pipeline valid state instead of hard 0, potentially correcting the m_axis_tlast=0 mismatch at cycle 7.
